study: Expert-curated historical browser observation replay. Explicit local subgoals and finite candidates are supplied. This is not an autonomous-browser benchmark or an independent holdout.

preparation.rotation: Move the first original option to the end. Expected index is (original expected + option count - 1) modulo option count. Canonical prediction is (request prediction + 1) modulo option count.
preparation.scoring: Report accuracy on accepted requests. Historical match, semantic acceptance and cookie wording sensitivity remain distinct. Rejections do not establish incorrect model choices.
